description: Verify the current price and availability of a product sold by a Shopify store that enabled MagicGEO Seller Agent. Facts are read live from the merchant's Shopify Admin at call time. Without variant_id, returns the product's variants with their state. With variant_id, returns state (VERIFIED, OUT_OF_STOCK or UNAVAILABLE), the offer facts, a short-lived Ed25519-signed passport (verify with jwks_url) and, when VERIFIED, a native Shopify checkout URL for one unit. Stock is never reserved; final price, taxes, shipping and payment are decided by Shopify checkout. Product IDs are listed in the store's agents.md.
name: verify_agent_offer
title: Verify a live Shopify offer (Seller Agent)
